explanation.title: Five factory actions. A repaired decoder.

paragraphs.text: Astra read the supplied project, repaired the decoder and CLI, added regression tests, ran npm test, and delivered. All five independent acceptance groups passed.

explanation.title: Astra reviews. Terra closes the gaps.

paragraphs.text: Terra repaired framing and decoding. Astra’s review reproduced a large-chunk CLI crash and found malformed UTF-8 file bytes being accepted through replacement decoding.

Terra repaired both issues and retained regressions. Astra inspected the integrated changes and exercised additional protocol boundaries. All five acceptance groups passed; both models’ usage is counted.
Sol repaired the decoder and added tests. Astra’s review then sent 150,000 frames through the CLI in one chunk and reproduced an argument-limit crash.

Astra assigned a focused repair. Sol replaced argument spreading with iterative collection, retained a large-chunk regression, and strengthened the base64 tests. The integrated product passed all five acceptance groups. Totals include both models.
